name: 阿知須温泉
sales_point: 山口市と宇部市の中間、阿知須町のなだらかな丘陵の田園地帯に位置する温泉地。周辺にゴルフ場、果樹園、テニスコートなど遊べる施設が充実している。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the gentle hills of Achisu Town, situated between Yamaguchi City and Ube City. The area is rich in recreational facilities such as golf courses, orchards, and tennis courts.

name: 荒木温泉
sales_point: 粟野川上流の小盆地に位置する温泉地。山懐に抱かれた閑静な環境。鮎釣り、梨狩りなど楽しめる。
review_summary:
Guests consistently praise this onsen for its wide variety of clean baths, including outdoor options and jacuzzis, as well as saunas featuring self-löyly. The helpful staff and convenient parking further enhance the positive experience.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be small.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in a small basin upstream of the Awano River. It offers a quiet environment embraced by the mountains, perfect for enjoying ayu fishing and pear picking.

name: 一の俣温泉
sales_point: 豊田富士と呼ばれる一位々岳の山裾に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、保養に好適。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers a wide variety of delicious dishes, including fresh abalone and fugu hot pot, and highlight the exceptional quality of the "torotoro" hot spring baths. They also appreciate the warm and attentive staff, as well as the option to use the sister hotel's facilities.

Some reviews mention the service can be inefficient.
sales_point_en: Situated at the foot of Mount Ichii, also known as Toyotafuji, this hot spring area is in a tranquil environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 江汐温泉
location: 山口県 山陽小野田市
sales_point: 瀬戸内海へ注ぐ有帆川沿いに位置する温泉地。緑が豊かな山あいの閑静な環境にある。保養・休養に好適。
sales_point_en: Located along the Yuhon River, which flows into the Seto Inland Sea, this hot spring area is surrounded by lush greenery and offers a peaceful environment, suitable for rest and recuperation.

name: 江汐湖温泉
location: 山口県 山陽小野田市
sales_point: 江汐公園内の湖に面した高台に位置する温泉地。春には5万本のつつじが咲き乱れる。家族連れの憩いの地として、秋芳洞などを巡る観光基地として最適。
sales_point_en: This hot spring area is situated on a hill overlooking a lake in Eshio Park. In spring, 50,000 azaleas bloom beautifully. It is an ideal spot for families and serves as a base for sightseeing, including visits to Akiyoshido Cave.

name: 王司温泉
sales_point: ＪＲ長府駅の北方約4キロに位置する温泉地。住宅街が近く、近郊の人々から親しまれている。
sales_point_en: Located about 4 kilometers north of JR Chofu Station, this hot spring area is close to residential neighborhoods and is well-loved by local residents.

name: 大河内温泉
sales_point: 狗留孫山の西側山麓に位置する温泉地。本郷川沿いの閑静な環境にある。江戸中期から湯治場として利用されてきたと伝えられ、保養・静養に好適。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hot spring features a unique alkaline spring water that leaves skin feeling smooth, with both heated and natural cold spring baths available. They also highlight the affordable 550 yen entry fee, free lockers, and the availability of shampoo and body soap.

Other reviews mention the staff can be unprofessional.
sales_point_en: Nestled at the western foot of Mount Kurumazaka, this hot spring area is in a quiet environment along the Hongogawa River. It has been used as a healing spot since the mid-Edo period, making it suitable for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 片倉温泉
sales_point: 沢波川の川畔に位置する温泉地。170年の歴史を持つ。閑静な環境で保養・休養に好適。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers natural hot spring baths, including open-air options and saunas, and provides great value for the price.

Other reviews mention shampoo and body soap can be unavailable, and the outdoor bath can be small.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located by the Sawanami River, boasting a history of 170 years. It offers a tranquil environment, perfect for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 片添ヶ浜温泉
location: 山口県 大島郡周防大島町
sales_point: 瀬戸内海の屋代島に位置する温泉地。伊予灘に面した片添ヶ浜に位置し、風光明媚。海水浴場やオートキャンプ場等が整備されている。夏にはビーチバレー大会など色々なイベントも多い。
sales_point_en: Situated on Yashiro Island in the Seto Inland Sea, this hot spring area is located at Katazoe Beach, known for its scenic beauty. It features well-maintained swimming beaches and auto camping sites, with various events like beach volleyball tournaments in summer.

name: 鹿野温泉
sales_point: 錦川沿いに位置する温泉地。プールやテニスコート等のスポーツ施設が整備されている。渓流釣りやスポーツを満喫できる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers good quality natural hot spring baths, with some featuring open-air options and saunas. Guests also highlight the delicious and reasonably priced meals, especially the local vegetable and soba dishes.

Other reviews mention the bathing area can be small.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Nishiki River, equipped with sports facilities such as pools and tennis courts. It is perfect for enjoying stream fishing and various sports.

name: 上関温泉
location: 山口県 熊毛郡平生町
sales_point: 平生町の南部、三方を海に囲まれて自然豊かな場所にある温泉地。温泉は塩分が強いが海水浴をした時のようにベタベタせずさらっとしている。
review_summary:
Visitors say this hot spring facility offers unique red-brown and clear baths, a spacious sauna, and a variety of amenities including shampoo and conditioner. They also highlight the beautiful views of the Seto Inland Sea from the outdoor bath and the clean, well-maintained facilities.

Some reviews mention the food can be inconsistent.
sales_point_en: Located in the southern part of Hirō Town, surrounded by the sea on three sides, this hot spring area is rich in nature. The hot spring has a strong salt content but feels smooth and not sticky like seawater.

name: 川棚温泉
sales_point: 鬼ヶ城連山の裾に位置する温泉地。800年の歴史を誇り、室町時代に三恵寺の怡雲和尚が掘り当てたと伝えられる。瓦そばが名物。関門の奥座敷として人気。
sales_point_en: Situated at the foot of the Onigajo Mountain Range, this hot spring area boasts an 800-year history, believed to have been discovered by the monk Iiun of Sankeiji Temple during the Muromachi period. It is famous for its kawara soba and is popular as a retreat in the Kanmon area.

name: 菊川温泉
sales_point: 皮膚病に特効のある温泉として知られる。平成3年から新源泉に変わり、湯量豊富。温水プールも併設されている。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers clean, spacious rooms and a relaxing hot spring bath with good water quality. They also highlight the friendly and helpful staff, as well as the quiet atmosphere.

Other reviews mention the hot spring water can be trucked in.
sales_point_en: Known for its effectiveness against skin diseases, this hot spring has changed to a new source since Heisei 3, providing abundant hot water. It also features a heated swimming pool.

name: 黄波戸温泉
sales_point: 黄波戸漁港沿いに位置する温泉地。海青島と日本海の眺望が良く、日本海の幸が美味。湯は海中から湧出する。釣りや海水浴の拠点に最適。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a relaxing open-air bath with stunning ocean views and a smooth, skin-softening alkaline spring water. They also highlight the affordable 400 yen entry fee and the availability of shampoo and body soap.

Some reviews mention there can be no cold bath.
sales_point_en: Located along Kibato Fishing Port, this hot spring area offers great views of Aoi Island and the Sea of Japan, with delicious seafood from the Japan Sea. The hot spring water springs from the sea, making it an ideal base for fishing and beach activities.

name: 錦帯橋温泉
sales_point: 錦川の清流沿いに位置する温泉地。錦帯橋と岩国城が近く、対岸の吉香公園には武家屋敷があり、城下町の情緒が残されている。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hot spring offers stunning views of Kintai Bridge and Iwakuni Castle from its open-air baths and terrace, with amenities like quality bath products. They also highlight the relaxing atmosphere, especially during less crowded times, and the convenience of provided towels.

Some reviews mention the outdoor bath can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: Situated along the clear stream of the Nishiki River, this hot spring area is close to Kintai Bridge and Iwakuni Castle. The nearby Yoshikō Park features samurai residences, preserving the charm of a castle town.

name: 玉泉湖温泉
sales_point: 防府市北西部の玉泉留池近くに位置する温泉地。三基の釜風呂が名物。
sales_point_en: Located near Gyokusen Reservoir in the northwest part of Hofu City, this hot spring area is famous for its three kettle baths.

name: 桑山温泉
sales_point: 防府駅南側の桑山公園近くに位置する温泉地。
sales_point_en: This hot spring area is located near Kuwayama Park, south of Hofu Station.

name: 島地温泉
sales_point: 徳地ICの南東、島地川河畔に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境で保養・休養に好適。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring offers delicious food, including natural yam dishes and soft-serve ice cream, and the bath water is a comfortable temperature. They also highlight the friendly staff, reasonable prices, and clean restrooms.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be small.
sales_point_en: Located southeast of Tokuchi IC, along the banks of the Shimaji River, this hot spring area offers a quiet environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 持世寺温泉
sales_point: 厚東川に沿った霜降山の北側山麓に位置する温泉地。武士の療養に利用されたと伝えられる。閑静な環境にあり、保養・静養に好適。
sales_point_en: Situated on the northern foothills of Shimofuri Mountain along the Kōtō River, this hot spring area is said to have been used for the healing of samurai. It is in a tranquil environment, perfect for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 周防大島温泉
location: 山口県 大島郡周防大島町
sales_point: 屋代島の入口、大島大橋近くに位置する温泉地。瀬戸の渦潮を望む露天風呂は絶景。名物の「えん歌風呂」が人気。瀬戸内の海鮮料理を楽しめる。
sales_point_en: Located near the entrance of Yashiro Island, close to the Ōshima Ohashi Bridge, this hot spring area features an open-air bath with a stunning view of the Seto whirlpools. The popular 'Enka Bath' and delicious Setouchi seafood dishes are highlights.

name: 雙津峡温泉
sales_point: 宇佐川の清流沿いに位置する温泉地。一帯が西中国山地国定公園に指定され、自然環境がよい。雙津峡、深谷峡、寂地峡探勝やハイキング、釣りに好適。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers excellent quality hot spring water, often described as smooth and warm, with some noting its immediate skin-softening effects. Guests also appreciate the delicious and generous meals, the clean and well-maintained facilities, and the helpful staff.

Other reviews mention the shower water pressure can be weak.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the clear stream of the Usa River. The entire area is designated as part of the Chugoku Mountains National Park, offering a great natural environment. Ideal for exploring Soujinkyo, Fukaya Gorge, and Jakkokyo, as well as hiking and fishing.

name: 滝部温泉
sales_point: 山口県西北端の豊北町のほぼ中央に位置する温泉地。小高い丘に位置し眺望が良い。海水浴の基地に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located almost in the center of Toyohoku Town, at the northwestern tip of Yamaguchi Prefecture. Situated on a small hill, it offers great views and is suitable as a base for beach activities.

name: 俵山温泉
sales_point: 四方を山に囲まれた山間の峡谷沿いに位置する温泉地。歴史が永く、リウマチに特効があると言われ、保養・療養に好適。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along a mountain valley surrounded by mountains. It has a long history and is said to be effective for rheumatism, making it suitable for recuperation and therapy. Designated as a national health resort.

name: 長府温泉
sales_point: ＪＲ長府駅の北東に位置する温泉地。関門海峡に面し、景観がよい。駅に近く、アクセスの便が良い。
review_summary: Guests mention this hotel offers beautiful ocean views from the rooms and private open-air baths, along with delicious and carefully prepared meals. They also highlight the exceptional hospitality and attentive staff, who provide excellent service. Visitors appreciate the quiet and relaxing atmosphere, making it ideal for a peaceful retreat.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located northeast of JR Chofu Station. Facing the Kanmon Straits, it offers beautiful scenery and is conveniently accessible due to its proximity to the station.

name: 津波敷温泉
sales_point: 響灘に面した海岸沿いに位置する温泉地。海に沈む夕陽が宅に美しい。北方に弥生時代の土井ヶ浜遺跡がある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the coast facing Hibikinada. The sunset over the sea is beautiful. To the north, there are the Doi Beach ruins from the Yayoi period.

name: 長沢温泉
sales_point: 県都山口市の南部に位置する長沢池畔にある温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、保養・静養向き
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located by Nagasawa Pond in the southern part of Yamaguchi City. It is in a quiet environment, suitable for recuperation and relaxation.

name: 長門湯本温泉
sales_point: 室町時代初期に発見されたと伝えられる温泉地。音信川の両岸に温泉街が形成され、情緒深い。自然環境に恵まれ、初夏には源氏ボタルが飛び交う。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area believed to have been discovered in the early Muromachi period. A hot spring town has formed along both banks of the Onshin River, rich in atmosphere. Blessed with a great natural environment, fireflies can be seen in early summer.

name: 西市温泉
sales_point: 清流木屋川の傍らに位置する温泉地。夏は部屋からホタルも眺められる。名産品の鮎や梨を堪能できる。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring has a unique, thick, and smooth water quality that leaves skin feeling soft and moisturized, with spacious indoor and outdoor baths. They also highlight the affordable prices, convenient location within a roadside station, and ample parking.

Some reviews mention the staff can be impolite.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located next to the clear stream of the Kiyagawa River. In summer, fireflies can be seen from the rooms. Guests can enjoy local specialties such as sweetfish and pears.

name: 日本海温泉テルメ阿胡温泉
location: 山口県 阿武郡阿武町
sales_point: 国道191号線沿いの阿武町「道の駅」の中に位置する温泉地。食堂、プール、特産品直売所も併設されている。萩観光の拠点に最適。日本海の幸を堪能できる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers stunning views of the Japan Sea from the bath and features a recently renovated, clean sauna. They also highlight the affordable price, JAF discounts, and convenient, spacious lockers.

Other reviews mention the bathing area can be limited.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located within the 'Road Station' in Abu Town along National Route 191. It features a dining area, pool, and a direct sales shop for local specialties. Ideal as a base for sightseeing in Hagi, where you can enjoy the seafood of the Japan Sea.

name: 萩温泉
sales_point: 萩市で唯一の温泉地。モノレールで行く紅葉谷露天風呂、市街地と日本海を一望できるパノラマ展望台があり、見所も多い。
review_summary: Guests mention this hotel offers a wide variety of hot springs, including open-air baths, jacuzzis, and saunas, and highlight the delicious and plentiful meals, especially the fresh seafood and local dishes. They also appreciate the exceptional service from the staff, who are described as attentive, friendly, and welcoming from arrival to departure.
sales_point_en: The only hot spring area in Hagi City. It features an open-air bath in Momijidani accessible by monorail, and a panoramic observation deck offering views of the city and the Japan Sea, with many attractions.

name: 三丘温泉
sales_point: 島田川沿いの県立自然公園内に位置する温泉地。田園風景の広がるのどかな環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。島田川の河床から湧き、1955年鶴が傷を癒していたことから発見されたと伝えられる。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located within a prefectural natural park along the Shimada River. It is in a tranquil environment with rural scenery, suitable for recuperation and therapy. It is said to have been discovered in 1955 when a crane was healing its wounds in the riverbed. Designated as a national health resort.

name: 室積温泉
sales_point: 海岸に面する丘陵地に位置する温泉地。眼下には瀬戸内海国立公園や室積半島など、大パノラマが広がる。眺望は素晴らしく、保養客や海水浴客で賑わう。
review_summary:
Guests praise the hotel's delicious and creative cuisine, which includes good local specialties and a complimentary late-night tantanmen ramen. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the stunning ocean views available from both the rooms and the public bath.

Other reviews mention there can be a lack of air conditioning.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on a hill facing the coast. A grand panorama unfolds below, including Setonaikai National Park and Murozumi Peninsula. The views are spectacular, attracting many guests for recuperation and beach activities.

name: 由宇温泉
sales_point: 由宇川のほとりに位置する温泉地。山あいの静寂な谷間にあり、閑静な環境。岩国カントリークラブに隣接しており、ゴルフ客や静養客の利用が多い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located by the Yuu River. Nestled in a quiet valley surrounded by mountains, it offers a tranquil environment. Adjacent to Iwakuni Country Club, it is popular among golf and relaxation guests.

name: 湯谷温泉
sales_point: 県道33号線沿い、下関ゴールデンＧＣに隣接している温泉地。ラジウム含有量が高い。吉田山峡に位置し、静かな環境にある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along Prefectural Road 33, adjacent to Shimonoseki Golden Golf Club. It has a high radium content and is situated in a quiet environment in the Yoshida Mountain Gorge.

name: 湯田温泉
sales_point: 県都山口市の南西部に位置する温泉地。600年の歴史を有し、近代設備が完備された老舗旅館やホテルが建ち並ぶ。山陽路随一の名湯と言われ、湯量も多い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the southwestern part of Yamaguchi City. With a history of 600 years, it features long-established inns and hotels equipped with modern facilities. Known as one of the best hot springs in the Sanyo region, it has abundant hot water.

name: 湯野温泉
sales_point: 夜市川の上流沿いに位置する温泉地。山紫明水な環境にあり、徳山の奥座敷とも呼ばれる。「坊ちゃん」のモデル弘中又一の故郷でもある。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring inn offers a wide variety of clean, renovated baths, including private open-air options and a highly praised "beauty water" quality. Guests also highlight the delicious in-room dining, attentive staff, and peaceful atmosphere.

Some reviews mention the hot spring baths can be lukewarm.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the upper reaches of the Yomichi River. It is in a serene environment, often referred to as the back room of Tokuyama. It is also the hometown of the model for 'Botchan', Hiro-naka Mataichi.

name: 柚木慈生温泉
sales_point: 大原湖の上流に位置する温泉地。湯は茶色で飲用効果が高く、泉質は優れている。県内外からの湯治客が多い。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features a rare, highly concentrated carbonated spring with a comfortable, low temperature that allows for long soaks. They also highlight the delicious homemade apple pie and bento boxes available for purchase.

Some reviews mention the bathing area can be cramped.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located upstream of Ohara Lake. The water is brown and has high drinking effects, with excellent water quality. It attracts many guests from both inside and outside the prefecture for therapeutic purposes.

name: 湯の口温泉
location: 山口県 美祢郡美東町
sales_point: 長川の川畔に位置する温泉地。秋吉台国定公園の探勝の基地に好適。山口、宇部観光にも便利。
review_summary:
Guests mention this inn offers spacious, clean rooms with private open-air baths, delicious and voluminous meals, and well-maintained saunas. They also highlight the quiet, relaxing atmosphere, attentive staff, and complimentary drinks in the changing rooms.

Some reviews mention the day-use fee can be expensive.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located by the Nagagawa River. It is ideal as a base for exploring Akiyoshidai National Park. Convenient for sightseeing in Yamaguchi and Ube.

name: 湯の瀬温泉
sales_point: 阿武川の河畔に位置する温泉地。長門峡の入口の山あいにあり、閑静な環境。保養・静養に好適。釣りやハイキングも楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located by the banks of the Abu River. Nestled in a quiet mountain area at the entrance of Nagato Gorge, it is suitable for recuperation and relaxation. Fishing and hiking can also be enjoyed.

name: 湯の峠温泉
location: 山口県 山陽小野田市
sales_point: 厚狭川の渓谷を望む山あいに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains overlooking the Asahi River gorge. It is in a quiet environment, suitable for recuperation and therapy.

name: 湯免温泉
sales_point: 三隅川沿いに位置する温泉地。弘法大師が開湯したと伝えられる古湯で歴史が永い。周辺は田園地帯ののどかな環境で、保養・静養に好適。
sales_point_en: A historic hot spring located along the Misumi River, said to have been opened by Kobo Daishi. It offers a tranquil rural environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 油谷湾温泉
sales_point: 油谷湾に面した温泉地。一帯が北長門海岸国定公園に指定され、海辺の景観が良い。「楊貴妃伝説」が残る海を眺めての展望風呂は最高。特に夕陽が美しい。
review_summary: Guests mention this hotel offers rooms that are clean and recently renovated, with many highlighting the stunning ocean views from both rooms and the open-air baths. They also frequently praise the "torotoro" (thick and smooth) quality of the hot spring water, noting its skin-softening benefits. Visitors consistently commend the staff for their warm, attentive, and professional service.
sales_point_en: A hot spring facing Yuyawan Bay, designated as part of the North Nagato Coast National Park, offering beautiful seaside views. The open-air bath with a view of the sea, linked to the 'Yang Guifei Legend', is particularly stunning at sunset.

name: 吉見温泉
sales_point: 下関市の北部、県道下関川棚線沿いに位置する温泉地。吉見海水浴場が近く、閑静な環境にある。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a unique experience with its cold spring source and two baths, one heated and one with natural spring water. Guests mention the alkaline spring water leaves skin feeling smooth, and appreciate the availability of family baths.

Other reviews mention the bathing area can be cramped.
sales_point_en: Located in the northern part of Shimonoseki City along the Prefectural Road Shimonoseki-Kawabata, this hot spring is near Yoshimi Beach and offers a quiet environment.

name: 呼鶴温泉
sales_point: 熊毛町南部の田園地帯に位置する温泉地。世界屈指のラジウム含有量を誇ると言われる。のどかな環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: Situated in the rural area of Kumage Town, this hot spring is said to boast one of the highest radium contents in the world. It provides a peaceful environment, perfect for recuperation and relaxation.

name: 粟井温泉
sales_point: 岡山市の北西端に位置する温泉地。山間の田園風景の中で、閑静な環境にある。
sales_point_en: Located at the northwestern edge of Okayama City, this hot spring is nestled in a quiet rural landscape.

name: あわくら温泉
location: 岡山県 英田郡西粟倉村
sales_point: 塩谷川沿いに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり保養休養に好適。
review_summary:
Visitors say this hot spring features a variety of baths, including a spacious open-air bath with stunning natural views and the soothing sound of a nearby river. They also highlight the reasonable prices, friendly staff, and convenient amenities like towel rentals.

Some reviews mention the facilities can be dated.
sales_point_en: A hot spring along the Shiotani River, set in a tranquil environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 怒塚山温泉
sales_point: 金甲山の北側山麓に位置する温泉地。高台に位置しており、児島湖の眺望が良い。
sales_point_en: Located on the northern foothills of Kinkou Mountain, this hot spring offers great views of Kojima Lake from its elevated position.

name: 浮田温泉
sales_point: 足守川支流の浮田川に沿いに位置する温泉地。周辺は田園風景が広がり、ひなびた風情が漂う。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers spacious and clean baths, including a wide outdoor bath with stunning views of the Seto Inland Sea, and a well-designed sauna. Guests also highlight the delicious food, helpful staff, and the convenience of provided towels and loungewear.

Some reviews mention the admission fees can be expensive.
sales_point_en: Situated along the Ukita River, a tributary of the Asahi River, this hot spring is surrounded by rural scenery, exuding a rustic charm.

name: 奥津温泉
location: 岡山県 苫田郡鏡野町
sales_point: 中国山地の内懐に位置する温泉地。自然環境に恵まれ、日本観光地百選に選ばれている。川畔の露天風呂で「足踏み洗濯」の奇習が残されている。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: Nestled in the inner reaches of the Chugoku Mountains, this hot spring is blessed with a rich natural environment and is selected as one of Japan's top 100 tourist destinations. It features an open-air bath by the river where the unique custom of 'foot washing laundry' remains. A national health resort.

name: 奥湯郷温泉
sales_point: 西日本の県営ラグビーサッカー場が整備されている温泉地。スポーツの合宿や、試合が行われる。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring facility offers a variety of indoor and outdoor baths, including jet baths and saunas, with many finding the water temperature pleasant for long soaks. Visitors also highlight the reasonable 800 yen entry fee, ample parking, and the option for private family baths.

Some reviews mention the family baths can be expensive.
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located near a prefectural rugby and soccer field in western Japan, making it suitable for sports training camps and matches.

name: 上斎原温泉
location: 岡山県 苫田郡鏡野町
sales_point: 斎原村の山あいに位置する温泉地。自然環境に恵まれ、休養・保養に好適。野鳥のさえずりを聞きながら「のんびり」「ゆったり」くつろげる。日帰りの入浴施設が平成11年7月にオープン。
sales_point_en: Located in the mountains of Saihara Village, this hot spring is surrounded by a rich natural environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation. Visitors can unwind while listening to the chirping of wild birds. A day-use bathing facility opened in July 1999.

name: 倉敷王子が岳温泉
sales_point: 奇岩・巨岩が圧巻の王子が岳の山麓に位置する温泉地。瀬戸内海の眺望が良い。壮大な瀬戸大橋を遠望できる。
review_summary: Visitors say this destination offers stunning views of the Seto Inland Sea and the Seto Ohashi Bridge, with opportunities for paragliding. They also highlight the walking trails to unique rock formations like "Nikoniko Iwa" and the presence of cats and wild boars. Guests mention the cafe provides a pleasant atmosphere to enjoy coffee while taking in the scenic surroundings.
sales_point_en: Situated at the foothills of the impressive Ouji-ga-take, known for its strange and giant rocks, this hot spring offers great views of the Seto Inland Sea and a distant view of the magnificent Seto Ohashi Bridge.

name: 倉見温泉
sales_point: 倉見川沿いに位置する温泉地。静かな林の中にあり、保養・休養に好適。キャンプや釣りが楽しめる。
sales_point_en: Located along the Kurami River, this hot spring is nestled in a quiet forest, ideal for relaxation and recuperation. It offers opportunities for camping and fishing.

name: 小森温泉
location: 岡山県 加賀郡吉備中央町
sales_point: 旭川の支流、豊岡川沿いの山間に位置する温泉地。享保年間に備前藩主によって発見されたと伝えられる。
review_summary:
Visitors say this hot spring offers two types of baths with excellent, high-quality alkaline water that leaves skin feeling smooth and warm. They also highlight the charming, retro atmosphere and the availability of free hairdryer rentals.

Some reviews mention the price for amenities can be high.
sales_point_en: This hot spring is situated in the mountains along the Toyooka River, a tributary of the Asahi River, and is said to have been discovered by the Bizen feudal lord during the Kyoho era.

name: 郷緑（湯原温泉郷）
sales_point: 旭川の支流、鉄山川沿いに位置する温泉地。湯原温泉郷のひとつに数えられ、閑静な環境。保養・静養に好適。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary: Visitors say this hot spring offers a unique experience with fresh, lukewarm water bubbling directly from the bedrock into the bath, and a separate hot bath for warming up. They also highlight the private 30-minute sessions for 500 yen per person, allowing for a relaxing and undisturbed soak. Guests mention the water leaves their skin feeling smooth and appreciate the welcoming staff.
sales_point_en: Located along the Tetsuzan River, a tributary of the Asahi River, this hot spring is one of the Yuhara Onsen district, set in a quiet environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation. A national health resort.

name: 鷺の巣温泉
location: 岡山県 加賀郡吉備中央町
sales_point: 吉備高原の一角に位置する温泉地。「吉備津彦命と温羅」の伝説が残されており、歴史が永い。吉備高原周辺観光の拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: Situated in a corner of the Kibi Highlands, this hot spring is steeped in history, linked to the legend of Kibi no Tsukuyomi and Ura. It serves as a great base for sightseeing around the Kibi Highlands.

name: 作州武蔵温泉
sales_point: 作州武蔵カントリークラブに隣接した温泉地。お風呂からはゴルフ場の美しい緑が眺められる。久賀ダム探勝基地にも良い。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers delicious meals, especially the freshly fried tempura and all-you-can-eat sea bream rice, along with a wide selection of drinks. They also highlight the clean and spacious rooms, well-maintained hot springs with open-air baths, and attentive staff.

Other reviews mention the food can be inconsistent.
sales_point_en: Adjacent to the Sakushu Musashi Country Club, this hot spring offers beautiful views of the golf course's greenery from the bath. It is also a good base for exploring the Kuga Dam.

name: 瀬戸大橋温泉
sales_point: ＪＲ庭瀬駅の西方に位置する温泉地。交通の便がよく、倉敷駅からも近い。周辺に倉敷チボリ公園美鶴地区等見所も多い。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring hotel offers a wide variety of baths, including spacious indoor and open-air options, and provides free admission to popular theatrical performances for guests.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be dated and the bathhouse floor can be slippery.
sales_point_en: Located west of JR Niwase Station, this hot spring is conveniently accessible and close to Kurashiki Station. The surrounding area features many attractions, including Kurashiki Tivoli Park and the Mitsuru District.

name: 総社温泉
sales_point: 総社市の北部、秋葉山の山麓に位置する温泉地。林に囲まれた閑静な環境にある。雪舟ゆかりの宝福寺が近く、国分寺など史跡探勝基地に好適。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring offers a variety of baths, including indoor and open-air options, a sauna, and amenities like shampoo and conditioner. Guests also highlight the affordable entry fee and the clean, well-maintained facilities.

Other reviews mention the changing rooms can be difficult to use.
sales_point_en: Located in the northern part of Soja City at the foothills of Mount Akihayama, this hot spring is surrounded by a quiet forest. It is close to historical sites like Hōfuku-ji Temple, associated with the famous painter Sesshu, making it a great base for exploring.

name: たまの温泉
sales_point: 渋川海岸沿いに位置する温泉地。瀬戸内海の眺望が良く、マリンスポーツが楽しめる。風光明媚な環境で、夏は家族連れなどで賑わう。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers spacious and clean baths, including a wide outdoor bath with stunning views of the Seto Inland Sea, and a well-designed sauna. Guests also highlight the delicious food, helpful staff, and the convenience of provided towels and loungewear.

Some reviews mention the admission fees can be expensive.
sales_point_en: Situated along Shibukawa Beach, this hot spring offers great views of the Seto Inland Sea and opportunities for marine sports. It is a picturesque environment that attracts families, especially in summer.

name: 足（湯原温泉郷）
sales_point: 旭川の河原に位置している温泉地。対岸に共同浴場がある。湯原温泉郷のひとつに数えられ、素朴な湯治場の雰囲気が漂っている。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features smooth, alkaline hot spring water and offers both indoor and outdoor baths, including private family baths. Guests also highlight the spotless facilities, reasonable prices, and relaxing atmosphere.

Some reviews mention parking can be limited.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located by the banks of the Asahi River, with a public bath across the river. It is one of the Yubara Onsen areas, exuding a rustic hot spring atmosphere. A designated national health resort.

name: 月の原温泉
location: 岡山県 加賀郡吉備中央町
sales_point: 矢倉山、聖望山に囲まれた賀陽町の吉備高原の一角に位置する温泉地。周辺には田園風景が広がり、のどかな環境にある。吉備高原周辺観光の足場に好適。
review_summary: People say this natural open-air bath offers three types of hot springs with varying temperatures, including "Bijin no Yu" (hot spring for beauty) and "Kodakara no Yu" (hot spring for fertility). They also highlight the free admission and parking, as well as the 24-hour access. Visitors appreciate the soft water, which warms the body thoroughly, and the relaxing atmosphere by the river.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in a corner of Kibi Plateau, surrounded by Mount Yagurayama and Mount Seibo. The surrounding countryside offers a peaceful environment, making it ideal for sightseeing in the Kibi Plateau area.

name: 津黒高原温泉
sales_point: 標高600メートルの津黒高原に位置する温泉地。蒜山や大山の眺望が良い。ハイキング、スキー基地にも好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at an elevation of 600 meters on Tsuguro Plateau, offering great views of Hiruzen and Daisen. It is also suitable as a base for hiking and skiing.

name: 苫田温泉
sales_point: 岡山市北部の苫田川沿いに位置する温泉地。緑多いのどかで閑静な環境にある。周辺には果樹園が多くシーズン中は白桃、マスカットなどが味わえる。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen features a scenic open-air bath with stunning mountain views, and appreciate the clean and well-maintained facilities. They also highlight the pleasantly warm, slightly viscous water, which is ideal for long, relaxing soaks. Guests mention the helpful staff and the convenient on-site dining options, including local river fish dishes.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Tomata River in the northern part of Okayama City. It is in a lush, tranquil environment, surrounded by many orchards where you can enjoy white peaches and muscats during the season.

name: 百々温泉
sales_point: 加茂川沿いに位置する温泉地。のどかな田園風景の閑静な環境にある。保養・静養に好適。
review_summary:
Guests mention this onsen has a variety of baths, including a jacuzzi, walking bath, and medicinal herb bath, and the facilities are clean and well-maintained. They also highlight the affordable entry fee and spacious resting areas, which are perfect for relaxing after a bath.

Other reviews mention the sauna can be out of order.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Kamo River, in a quiet environment with serene rural scenery. It is ideal for recuperation and relaxation.

name: 東吉備高原温泉
location: 岡山県 和気郡和気町
sales_point: 備前ｺﾞﾙﾌ倶楽部の南側に位置する温泉地。町には自然保護センターがあり、丹頂鶴を見ることができる。こんにゃくやメロンが名産。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers a convenient 24-hour convenience store on-site and a wide variety of modern equipment, including ping-pong tables and manga. They also highlight the complimentary welcome drinks, delicious katsudon, and private family baths.

Other reviews mention there can be limited dining options.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located south of Bizen Golf Club. The town has a nature conservation center where you can see red-crowned cranes. Konnyaku and melons are local specialties.

name: 真賀（湯原温泉郷）
sales_point: 足温泉の南方にある温泉情緒溢れた温泉地。湯原温泉郷の一角。かつて津山藩の浴場だった。共同浴場の幕湯が名物。静養・療養に好適。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary: People say this onsen has excellent quality, lukewarm water that leaves skin feeling smooth and soft. They also highlight the reasonable prices for both the gender-separated baths and the mixed-gender Makuyu bath. Guests mention the quiet and relaxing atmosphere, making it a great place for a peaceful soak.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area rich in hot spring charm, located south of Ashi Onsen. It is part of the Yubara Onsen area and was once a bathhouse for the Tsuyama domain. The public bath 'Makuyu' is a specialty. Ideal for recuperation and therapy. A designated national health resort.

name: 宮本温泉
sales_point: 吉野川沿いの宮本地区に位置する温泉地。この地区は宮本武蔵生誕の地と伝えられている。閑静な環境にあり、休養・保養に好適。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring facility offers a variety of indoor and outdoor baths, including jet baths and saunas, with many finding the water temperature pleasant for long soaks. Visitors also highlight the reasonable 800 yen entry fee, ample parking, and the option for private family baths.

Some reviews mention the family baths can be expensive.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the Miyamoto district along the Yoshino River, believed to be the birthplace of Miyamoto Musashi. It is in a quiet environment, suitable for rest and recuperation.

name: 八幡温泉
location: 岡山県 御津郡建部町
sales_point: 旭川沿いに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境で保養・療養に好適。県下一の湧出量を誇る。町では温泉を利用して野菜を育てている。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring facility offers a variety of clean, well-maintained baths, including open-air baths, and features natural hot spring water. They also highlight the delicious food, reasonable prices, and spacious parking.

Some reviews mention the outdoor bath can be occupied.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Asahi River, in a quiet environment ideal for recuperation and therapy. It boasts the highest spring water output in the prefecture, and the town uses the hot spring water to grow vegetables.

name: 由加温泉
sales_point: 由加山の山麓に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にある。由加神社の門前にあり、参拝客の利用が多い。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers spacious, clean rooms, delicious Japanese cuisine, and a variety of baths including open-air and source-water options. They also highlight the attentive staff, quiet environment, and convenient shuttle service to nearby train stations.

Some reviews mention the road can be narrow.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of Mount Yuka, in a tranquil environment. It is situated in front of Yuka Shrine, frequented by worshippers.

name: 湯郷温泉
sales_point: 吉井川支流の吉野川沿いに位置する温泉地。1200年前、傷ついた白鷺に導かれ円仁法師の発見と伝えられ、鷺ノ湯とも呼ばれる。設備の整った宿が多く、近隣にはゴルフ場やテニスコート等が整備されている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Yoshino River, a tributary of the Yoshi River. It is said to have been discovered 1200 years ago, guided by an injured white heron, and is also known as 'Sagi no Yu'. Many well-equipped accommodations are available, with nearby golf courses and tennis courts.

name: 湯の瀬温泉
location: 岡山県 加賀郡吉備中央町
sales_point: 旭川の支流、豊岡川沿いに位置する温泉地。自然環境が良く、閑静な環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。
review_summary:
Visitors say this onsen has excellent quality hot spring water with a sulfur scent, and the showers also provide hot spring water. They also highlight the reasonable 700 yen fee, the clean facilities, and the friendly, attentive staff.

Some reviews mention the bathroom can be small.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Toyoka River, a tributary of the Asahi River. It has a good natural environment and is in a quiet area, making it suitable for recuperation and relaxation.

name: 湯迫温泉
sales_point: 竜ノ口の旧城跡に位置する温泉地。平安時代に開湯した歴史のあるいで湯。岡山市街を一望でき、眺望が良い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the site of the old castle ruins of Ryunokuchi. It has a long history, having opened in the Heian period. It offers great views of Okayama City.

name: 湯原（湯原温泉郷）
sales_point: 中国山地の山懐を流れる旭川沿いに位置する温泉地。湯原温泉郷の中心で湯原ダム直下の露天風呂「砂場」が名物。自然環境が良い。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Asahi River flowing through the mountains of the Chugoku region. It is the center of Yubara Onsen, famous for the open-air bath 'Sunaba' located just below Yubara Dam. The natural environment is excellent. A designated national health resort.

name: 湯免温泉
sales_point: 吉井川の支流、高田川沿いに位置する温泉地。大王山の山麓にあり、のどかな環境。保養・療養に好適。鮎釣り・キノコ狩りができる。
review_summary:
Guests consistently praise this onsen for its relaxing atmosphere, featuring natural hot spring water and a comfortable rock bath. They also appreciate the friendly staff, reasonable rental towel prices, and convenient early morning opening hours.

Other reviews mention the bathing area can be small.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Takada River, a tributary of the Yoshii River. It is situated at the foot of Mount Daiou, in a peaceful environment. Ideal for recuperation and therapy, with opportunities for ayu fishing and mushroom picking.

name: 和気鵜飼谷温泉
location: 岡山県 和気郡和気町
sales_point: ＪＲ和気駅から3キロの益原地区に位置する温泉地。PH9.5のアルカリ性単純温泉で湯量が豊富。家族からグループまで楽しめる。全天候型テニスコートや本格的屋内温水プールなどが整備されている。
review_summary:
Visitors say this hot spring facility offers a variety of baths, including open-air and medicinal options, with many highlighting the smooth, skin-softening alkaline water. They also appreciate the clean facilities, reasonable prices, and friendly local atmosphere.

Other reviews mention the atmosphere can be noisy.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located 3 kilometers from JR Wake Station in the Masuhara district. It features alkaline simple hot springs with a pH of 9.5 and abundant hot spring water. Suitable for families and groups, with all-weather tennis courts and a full-fledged indoor heated pool.

name: 鷲羽山吹上温泉
sales_point: 鷲羽山の高台に位置する温泉地。瀬戸内海を見下ろせ眺望が良い。鷲羽山唯一の天然温泉です。
review_summary: Guests mention this hotel offers stunning views of the Seto Ohashi Bridge from rooms and the open-air bath, along with delicious and varied buffet meals featuring fresh sushi and steak. They also highlight the all-inclusive plan, which covers drinks and snacks in the lounge, plus free activities like karaoke and table tennis. Visitors appreciate the friendly and attentive staff, as well as the clean and comfortable rooms.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on a high point of Washuzan, offering great views overlooking the Seto Inland Sea. It is the only natural hot spring on Washuzan.

name: 旭温泉
sales_point: 雲月山の山麓に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境で、保養・静養に好適。新緑や紅葉の素晴らしい自然郷。山の幸の宝庫。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of Mount Ungetsu. It is in a quiet environment, ideal for recuperation and relaxation, surrounded by beautiful nature in spring and autumn. A treasure trove of mountain delicacies.

name: 荒磯温泉
sales_point: 日本海に面した海岸沿いに位置する温泉地。海の眺めが良く、海水浴、釣りなどが楽しめる。目の前の海でとれた魚貝類が美味。
review_summary:
Guests mention this ryokan offers stunning ocean views from rooms and open-air baths, along with delicious, fresh seafood dishes like crispy fried flounder. They also highlight the friendly and attentive staff, and appreciate the tranquil atmosphere.

Some reviews mention the day-use hot springs can be unavailable.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the coast facing the Sea of Japan. It offers great views of the sea, with opportunities for swimming and fishing. The seafood caught right in front of the shore is delicious.

name: 有福温泉
sales_point: 石見高原の山あいに位置する温泉地。斜面に温泉街が雛壇状に形成されている。美人の湯としても有名。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains of Iwami Plateau. The hot spring town is formed in a terraced manner on the slopes. It is also famous for its beauty-enhancing waters.

name: 池田ラジウム温泉
sales_point: 三瓶山の西側、静間川の近くの山あいに位置する温泉地。ラジウム含有量が多く、日本でも指折りといわれる秘湯。三瓶山ではスキー、アウトドアが楽しめる。
sales_point_en: Located in the mountains near the Shizuma River on the west side of Mount Sanbe, this onsen is known for its high radium content and is considered one of Japan's hidden gems. Enjoy skiing and outdoor activities on Mount Sanbe.

name: 出雲須佐温泉
sales_point: 出雲市南、隣の佐田町に位置する温泉地。須佐川沿いにあり、川遊びや渓流釣りもできる。出雲市近辺の観光拠点に便利。
review_summary: Visitors say this shrine is a powerful and sacred place, highlighting the impressive 1,300-year-old sacred cedar tree behind the main hall. They also mention the serene and calming atmosphere, noting that the air feels different and offers a sense of peace. Guests appreciate the clean restrooms and convenient, ample parking.
sales_point_en: Situated south of Izumo City in the neighboring Sada Town, this onsen is along the Susa River, offering opportunities for river play and stream fishing. It serves as a convenient base for sightseeing around Izumo City.

name: 出雲湯村温泉
sales_point: 斐伊川上流の山峡に位置する温泉地。出雲風土記に「薬湯」と紹介された約1200年の暦酢或る古湯。斐伊川をはさみ木次町と吉田村にまたがっている。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen features open-air baths right by the river, offering a relaxing soak with the sound of the flowing water, and the alkaline spring water leaves skin smooth. They also highlight the mildly warm water, which is ideal for long soaks, and the reasonable 600 yen fee. Others also mention the clean changing rooms and the overall tranquil, rustic atmosphere.
sales_point_en: Nestled in a mountain gorge upstream of the Hi River, this ancient onsen is referred to as 'medicinal hot spring' in the Izumo Fudoki and has a history of about 1200 years. It spans across the towns of Kikisaki and Yoshida, separated by the Hi River.

name: いわみ温泉
location: 島根県 邑智郡邑南町
sales_point: 平成10年10月に香木の森公園に隣接してできた新しい温泉地。ハーブや薬草で効果を高めた露天風呂からの眺めは絶景。名物、石見牛を堪能できる。
sales_point_en: A new onsen developed in October 1998 adjacent to the Kōboku no Mori Park. The open-air bath enhanced with herbs and medicinal plants offers breathtaking views. Enjoy the local specialty, Iwami beef.

name: 海潮温泉
sales_point: 出雲大社の東、大蛇（おろち）退治伝説の残る斐伊川支流に位置する温泉地。1200年の歴史を持つ古湯。５月末から約１ヶ月間、赤川で源氏ホタルが乱舞する。
review_summary: Guests mention this hot spring inn offers a serene and peaceful atmosphere, with a smooth, skin-softening onsen featuring both indoor and spacious open-air baths. They also highlight the delicious and voluminous meals, including fresh sashimi and crispy tempura, served in a charming dining room. Visitors appreciate the attentive staff and the excellent value, especially during peak seasons.
sales_point_en: Located east of Izumo Taisha, this onsen is situated along a tributary of the Hi River, which is steeped in the legend of the Orochi serpent. It boasts a history of 1200 years. From late May for about a month, the Genji fireflies dance along the Akagawa River.

name: 潮温泉
location: 島根県 邑智郡美郷町
sales_point: 江ノ川水系県立自然公園内に位置する温泉地。江ノ川の清流沿いにあり、自然環境が良い。
sales_point_en: This onsen is located within the Enokawa River system prefectural natural park. It is along the clear stream of the Enokawa River, providing a great natural environment.

name: 小田温泉
sales_point: 小田川沿いに位置する温泉地。西方に日本海を望み自然環境が良い。町の名産品、いちじくや鮎なども楽しめる。
sales_point_en: Situated along the Oda River, this onsen offers a beautiful natural environment with views of the Japan Sea to the west. Enjoy local specialties such as figs and sweetfish.

name: 柿木温泉
location: 島根県 鹿足郡吉賀町
sales_point: 高津川と福川川の合流する柿木の小さな谷あいに位置する温泉地。村の中心部にある湯治場で、別名「弘法湯」と呼ばれる。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen features excellent hot spring water that is rich in minerals, with some noting the water is a comfortable temperature for long soaks. They also highlight the friendly and helpful staff, as well as the delicious food available at the on-site restaurant. Others mention the reasonable prices and the clean, well-maintained facilities.
sales_point_en: Located in a small valley where the Takatsu River and Fukukawa River converge, this onsen is a village center for hot spring bathing, also known as 'Kōbō-yu'.

name: 粕渕温泉
location: 島根県 邑智郡美郷町
sales_point: 町の中心地粕渕地域で新しく開発された温泉地。プール、サウナ、フィットネス器具をそろえた健康増進施設が併設されている。カヌーの里としても知られる。
sales_point_en: A newly developed onsen in the central Kasubuchi area of the town. It features health promotion facilities equipped with a pool, sauna, and fitness equipment. It is also known as a canoeing hub.

name: 風の国温泉
sales_point: 旭ICの北方約7キロの長谷地区に位置する温泉地。打たせ湯、寝湯、泡風呂、サウナなどが楽しめる。また園内には屋根付テニスコート、ゲートボール場、エビネラン培養センター、各種体験施設などがある。
review_summary:
Guests consistently praise this resort for its wide variety of children's activities and amenities, such as a spacious kids' room, outdoor play equipment, and a selection of picture books. They also highlight the delicious buffet meals with diverse options, complimentary welcome drinks and snacks, and the friendly staff.

Other reviews mention the staff can be indifferent.
sales_point_en: Located about 7 kilometers north of Asahi IC in the Nagase area, this onsen offers various bathing options including waterfall baths, sleeping baths, bubble baths, and saunas. The facility also includes covered tennis courts, gateball courts, an orchid cultivation center, and various experience facilities.

name: 上津井温泉
sales_point: 石見高原の一角、上津井川の河畔に位置する温泉地。のどかな雰囲気が漂い、保養に好適。日本海の幸を堪能できる。
sales_point_en: Situated along the banks of the Kamitsui River in the Iwami Plateau, this onsen offers a tranquil atmosphere ideal for relaxation. Enjoy the fresh seafood from the Japan Sea.

name: 木部谷温泉
location: 島根県 鹿足郡吉賀町
sales_point: 柿木村の木部谷に位置する温泉地。15分間隔で2.5メートル噴出する間欠泉がある。山あいの閑静な環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen features a unique, iron-rich, reddish-brown spring that warms the body thoroughly, and many highlight the rare geyser that erupts every 30 minutes. They also appreciate the ability to adjust the bath's temperature with steam and cold spring levers. Guests mention the friendly staff and the welcoming resident dog.
sales_point_en: Located in Kibedani of Kakigi Village, this onsen features a geyser that erupts every 15 minutes, shooting water 2.5 meters high. It is in a quiet mountain environment, perfect for relaxation and recuperation.

name: きまち温泉
sales_point: 来待川沿いに位置する温泉地。山あいの閑静な環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。母猿の傷を子猿が温泉で治したという伝説が残されている。
sales_point_en: This onsen is located along the Kimachi River in a quiet mountain environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation. There is a legend that a baby monkey healed its mother’s wounds in the hot spring.

name: 小屋原温泉
sales_point: 三瓶山北西側山麓、野城川沿いに位置する温泉地。歴史は古く、昔から湯治場として親しまれてきた閑静な環境にある。
review_summary: Guests mention this inn offers a wonderful authentic hot spring with strong carbonation that leaves skin feeling moisturized and the body warm. They also highlight the delicious meals, including handmade soba for dinner, and the peaceful atmosphere surrounded by nature. Others also say the staff are very kind and provide excellent service.
sales_point_en: Located along the Nojo River at the northwest foot of Mount Sanbe, this onsen has a long history and has been cherished as a hot spring retreat in a tranquil environment.

name: 湖陵温泉
sales_point: 神西湖の西岸に位置する温泉地。明るい雰囲気を持ち、出雲・石見の中継点にも便利。湖となだらかな中国山地の景観が美しい。また、伝説の池「蛇池・蓮池」が近く、自然を楽しむことが出来る。
review_summary:
Guests mention this inn offers delicious and beautifully presented kaiseki dinners and generous breakfasts featuring local ingredients. They also highlight the clean, renovated rooms with lake views, the relaxing hot springs, and the kind, attentive staff.

Some reviews mention there can be a musty odor.
sales_point_en: Situated on the west bank of Lake Jinsei, this onsen has a bright atmosphere and is conveniently located as a transit point between Izumo and Iwami. The scenery of the lake and the gentle Chugoku Mountains is beautiful. Nearby is the legendary 'Hebi-ike and Hasu-ike' where you can enjoy nature.

name: 鷺の湯温泉
sales_point: 中国山地から流れる飯梨川沿いに位置する温泉地。尼子氏の御殿場として栄えた薬効高い奥出雲の名湯。足立美術館も温泉街にあり、充実した内容。一帯が清水月山県立自然公園に指定されている。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: Located along the Iinari River flowing from the Chugoku Mountains, this onsen is a famous hot spring with medicinal properties that flourished as the residence of the Amako clan. The Adachi Art Museum is also in the hot spring area, providing a rich experience. The entire area is designated as a national health resort.

name: 三瓶温泉
sales_point: 三瓶山の南側中腹に位置する高原の温泉地。大山隠岐国立公園の中にあり、自然環境が良い。雲霧が多く神秘的な「雲海」が名物。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
sales_point_en: This highland onsen is located on the southern slope of Mount Sanbe. It is within the Daisen-Oki National Park, offering a great natural environment. The mystical 'sea of clouds' is a notable feature. It is designated as a national health resort.

name: 瀬戸ケ島温泉
sales_point: ＪＲ浜田駅の西方約2.5キロ、浜田漁港に面した瀬戸ヶ島町に位置する温泉地。釣りや海水浴などが楽しめる。
sales_point_en: Located about 2.5 kilometers west of JR Hamada Station, this onsen faces Hamada Fishing Port. Enjoy activities such as fishing and swimming.

name: 立久恵温泉
sales_point: 立久恵峡の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。自然の景観が良い。
sales_point_en: Situated along the Tachikue Gorge, this onsen offers beautiful natural scenery.

name: 玉造温泉
sales_point: 「出雲国風土記」にも記述のある古湯。宍道湖に注ぐ玉湯川の両岸に旅館街が広がる。落ち着いた雰囲気で松江・出雲大社など出雲路観光の拠点となっている。
sales_point_en: An ancient hot spring mentioned in the 'Izumo no Kuni Fudoki'. The ryokan area spreads along both banks of the Tamayu River, which flows into Lake Shinji. It has a calm atmosphere and serves as a base for sightseeing in Matsue and Izumo Taisha.

name: 断魚渓温泉
location: 島根県 邑智郡邑南町
sales_point: 濁川の渓谷、名勝「断魚渓」の近くに位置する温泉地。自然景観が良い。断魚渓谷探勝の拠点に好適。
review_summary:
Visitors say this tourist destination features dynamic river rapids, unique rock formations, and stunning autumn foliage. They also highlight the expansive "Senjojiki" rock formations and convenient parking.

Some reviews mention the paths can be slippery.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near the scenic Dangi Valley, known for its beautiful natural landscapes. It serves as a great base for exploring Dangi Valley.

name: 津和野温泉
location: 島根県 鹿足郡津和野町
sales_point: 野坂峠の北方、津和野町の中心部に位置する温泉地。森鴎外旧宅や津和野城跡など、見所も多く、観光拠点に最適。湯は「美人の湯」として親しまれている。
review_summary:
People say this toll road rest stop offers a wide variety of local produce, souvenirs, and Genji Maki, a traditional Japanese sweet. They also highlight the spacious parking, clean facilities, and the on-site hot spring with indoor and outdoor baths, a sauna, and a cold plunge.

Other reviews mention the restaurant can be under renovation.
sales_point_en: Situated in the center of Tsuwano, north of Nozaka Pass, this hot spring area is ideal for tourism with many attractions like the former residence of Mori Ogai and the ruins of Tsuwano Castle. The water is cherished as a 'beauty hot spring.'

name: 頓原温泉
location: 島根県 飯石郡飯南町
sales_point: 頓原川のひらけた一帯の山村に位置する温泉地。琴引山、草ノ城山などの山々の眺望が良い。スキー、登山などの基地にも好適。
review_summary: People say this onsen features natural carbonated spring water that is perfect for long, relaxing soaks, and many highlight the private baths with both warm and cold spring options. They also appreciate the reasonable prices and the staff's helpful and friendly service.
sales_point_en: Located in a mountainous village along the Tobuhara River, this hot spring offers great views of nearby mountains like Kotobiki and Kusanoshiro. It is also suitable as a base for skiing and hiking.

name: 華蔵温泉
sales_point: 子宝の神として知られる華蔵寺の近くに位置する温泉地。安土桃山時代の開湯と伝えられ、歴史が永い。山あいの豊かな自然の中でくつろげる。
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located near Kazukura Temple, known as the deity of fertility. It is said to have been established during the Azuchi-Momoyama period, boasting a long history and a relaxing atmosphere amidst rich natural surroundings.

name: 比田温泉
sales_point: 山間の田園地帯に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり保養療養向きで、お湯はアトピーにも良い。
sales_point_en: Nestled in a tranquil rural area surrounded by mountains, this hot spring is perfect for relaxation and recuperation, with waters beneficial for conditions like atopic dermatitis.

name: 斐乃上温泉
location: 島根県 仁多郡奥出雲町
sales_point: 船通山南側山麓に位置する温泉地。山あいの閑静な環境にあり、古くから薬効高い名湯として知られている。周囲の山々は新緑、紅葉ともに美しく、夏は避暑地としても快適に過ごせる。
sales_point_en: Located at the southern foot of Funatsutsumi Mountain, this hot spring is known for its therapeutic properties and serene mountain environment, making it a beautiful retreat in both summer and autumn.

name: 不老温泉
sales_point: 出雲大社の大鳥居の南方約2キロ、堀川河畔に位置する温泉地。日御碕や出雲大社観光に便利。稲佐浜海水浴場も近い。
sales_point_en: Situated about 2 kilometers south of the grand torii gate of Izumo Taisha, this hot spring is conveniently located for sightseeing at Hinomisaki and Izumo Taisha, with Inasa Beach nearby.

name: 益田温泉
sales_point: 益田川の支流沿いに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり休養・保養に好適。津和野、萩の観光拠点にも好適。
review_summary: Guests mention this hotel offers spacious, stylish, and clean rooms, often with comfortable beds and unique features like a raised sleeping area. They also highlight the fantastic onsen with a smooth, skin-softening alkaline water, a sauna, and a cold plunge pool. Visitors appreciate the delicious breakfast buffet featuring fresh, local vegetables and the friendly, welcoming staff.
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located along a tributary of the Masuda River, in a quiet environment ideal for relaxation and recuperation, also serving as a good base for exploring Tsuwano and Hagi.

name: 松江しんじ湖温泉
sales_point: 県都松江市の宍道湖北岸に位置する温泉地。眺望が良く、シジミをはじめとする松江・出雲観光の拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: Located on the northern shore of Lake Shinji in the prefectural capital Matsue, this hot spring offers great views and serves as a base for sightseeing in Matsue and Izumo, famous for its clams.

name: 美都温泉
location: 島根県 美濃郡美都町
sales_point: 笹ヶ峠の東側に位置する温泉地。四方を山に囲まれ、閑静な環境にある。つるつるとしたまろやかなお湯が評判で「美人湯」としても知られている。
review_summary: Visitors say this hot spring features spacious indoor and outdoor baths with a unique, smooth water quality that leaves skin feeling soft. They also highlight the delicious local produce and souvenirs available at the on-site shop and adjacent direct sales store. Guests mention the friendly staff and the relaxing atmosphere, making it a great place for a refreshing stop.
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located on the eastern side of Sasagatoge, surrounded by mountains in a quiet environment. It is known for its smooth and mild waters, also recognized as a 'beauty hot spring.'

name: 美又温泉
sales_point: 美又川沿いに位置する温泉地。明るい雰囲気で閑静な環境。源泉かけ流しの足湯がある。温泉のコインスタンドがあり、浴用として販売されている。美人の湯としても有名。
review_summary: People say this hot spring has exceptionally smooth, "torotoro" (thick and viscous) water that leaves skin feeling soft and moisturized. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the availability of free foot baths. Others mention the staff are friendly and the facilities are clean and well-maintained.
sales_point_en: Situated along the Mimata River, this hot spring has a bright atmosphere in a tranquil setting. It features a foot bath with flowing spring water and a coin-operated stand for bathing water, famous as a beauty hot spring.

name: 八雲温泉
sales_point: 天狗山を源にする意宇川が流れる静かな山あいの地に湧く温泉。
sales_point_en: A tranquil hot spring located in a mountainous area where the Oki River flows, originating from Tengu Mountain.

name: 湯抱温泉
location: 島根県 邑智郡美郷町
sales_point: 尻無川の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。春は桜、夏はホタルが舞い、閑静で風雅な環境。
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located along the Shirakawa Valley, where cherry blossoms bloom in spring and fireflies dance in summer, offering a serene and elegant environment.

name: 湯迫温泉
sales_point: 大森・硯銀山の入口にあたる湯迫谷に位置する温泉地。自然環境に恵まれ、静かで落ち着いた雰囲気を持つ。また、仁万漁港に上がった海の幸を味わうことが出来る。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring inn offers a quiet, relaxing atmosphere with a unique "beauty skin" hot spring that leaves skin smooth, and guests enjoy the delicious meals and affordable prices.

Other reviews mention the entrance can have a strong animal odor and the facilities can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: Located in the Yuhaku Valley at the entrance to Omori and Suwa Silver Mine, this hot spring is blessed with a natural environment, providing a quiet and calming atmosphere. You can also enjoy fresh seafood from the nearby Jinman Fishing Port.

name: 湯の川温泉
location: 島根県 簸川郡斐川町
sales_point: 三方を山に囲まれた田園風景の中に位置する温泉地。遙かに宍道湖を望み眺望が良い。群馬県の川中、和歌山県の龍神と共に「日本三大美人の湯」のひとつに数えられる。
sales_point_en: This hot spring is situated in a rural landscape surrounded by mountains, offering great views of Lake Shinji in the distance. It is counted among Japan's three major beauty hot springs, alongside those in Gunma and Wakayama.

name: 温泉津温泉
sales_point: 港周辺の湯町にある落ち着いた風情の温泉地。
sales_point_en: A calm and charming hot spring area located around the port.

name: 湯屋温泉
sales_point: 金城町中心部に新しく湧出した温泉地。温泉のコインスタンドがあり、飲用として販売されている。全国販売のミネラルウォーターの原水としても使用されている。
sales_point_en: A newly discovered hot spring in the center of Kanazaki Town, featuring a coin-operated stand for drinking water, which is also used as the source for nationally sold mineral water.

name: 岩倉温泉
sales_point: 小瀬川沿いに位置する温泉地。四方を山に囲まれ閑静な環境にある。保養・静養に好適。
review_summary: People say this campground offers clean and well-maintained cooking facilities, restrooms, and designated charcoal disposal areas. Visitors also highlight the convenient vehicle access to campsites, making loading and unloading easy, and appreciate the reasonable fees. They also like the flexible check-in and check-out times, allowing for extended stays.
sales_point_en: Located along the Koze River, this hot spring is surrounded by mountains in a quiet environment, ideal for recuperation and relaxation.

name: 潮原温泉
sales_point: 冠山の東側山麓に位置する温泉地。山間の閑静な環境にある。
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located at the eastern foot of Kanmuri Mountain, in a tranquil mountainous environment.

name: えたじま温泉
sales_point: 広島湾に浮かぶ江田島に位置する「えたじま温泉」は、穏やかな海景色に包まれた温泉です。瀬戸内の温暖な気候のもと、旅の疲れをやさしく癒やし、島ならではの静けさとくつろぎのひとときをお楽しみいただけます。
review_summary:
People say this onsen has a smooth, warming deep-sea salt spring with moisturizing effects, and the facilities are new and spotless. Guests also mention the staff are friendly and attentive, and the quiet atmosphere allows for a relaxing experience.

Other reviews mention the entrance fee can be expensive.
sales_point_en: Located on Etajima Island in Hiroshima Bay, Etajima Onsen is enveloped in gentle sea views. Under the mild climate of the Seto Inland Sea, it gently soothes travel fatigue, allowing you to enjoy the island's unique tranquility and relaxation.

name: 追分温泉
sales_point: 蟻ヶ平山の南方、尾原川沿いに位置する温泉地。すぐ近くに御年代古墳がある。広島空港への足場にも好適。
review_summary: People say this onsen features a nostalgic, retro atmosphere reminiscent of an old wooden schoolhouse, and offers a variety of local seafood dishes like abalone and whale. They also highlight the very reasonable 300 yen day-use fee and the numerous friendly cats on the premises. Guests mention the staff are welcoming and attentive, contributing to a relaxing experience.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Obara River, south of Mount Arigahira. Close to the ancient burial mound, it is also a convenient stop for Hiroshima Airport.

name: おおあさ鳴滝露天温泉
location: 広島県 山県郡北広島町
sales_point: 大朝ICの北方約3.5キロの山間に位置する温泉地。森野中にバンガローが建ち並び、ミニ温泉リゾート地にふさわしくアウトドアライフを満喫できる。日帰り入浴も可。
sales_point_en: Located about 3.5 kilometers north of Oasa IC, this hot spring area is nestled in the mountains. With bungalows lined up in the forest, it is perfect for enjoying an outdoor lifestyle, and day-use bathing is available.

name: 大久野島温泉
sales_point: 竹原市忠海港の南方約4キロの大久野島に位置する温泉地。フェリーで約15分と気軽に行くことができる。海水浴や釣り、マリンスポーツなどが楽しめる。
review_summary: People say this hotel offers clean, comfortable rooms with ocean views and a wide variety of delicious buffet options, including fresh seafood and Hiroshima beef. They also highlight the friendly and helpful staff, as well as the convenient free shuttle bus from the ferry terminal. Guests mention the unique opportunity to interact with numerous wild rabbits around the property, especially in the evenings and mornings.
sales_point_en: Situated on Okunoshima Island, about 4 kilometers south of Chudai Port in Takehara City. Easily accessible by a 15-minute ferry ride, it offers opportunities for swimming, fishing, and marine sports.

name: 小瀬川温泉
sales_point: 国道186号線沿いに位置する温泉地。山あいにあり、四季折々の自然にふれることができる。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring offers radon-rich waters that warm the body and leave skin smooth, with a cold spring water bath for a refreshing contrast. They also highlight the delicious udon and fried ayu, plus free drinking and hot spring water.

Other reviews mention the indoor bath can be neglected.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along National Route 186, surrounded by mountains, allowing visitors to experience the beauty of nature in all seasons.

name: 賀茂の里温泉
sales_point: 山陽道河内ICの北側に位置する温泉地。露天風呂が全部で7種類。家族揃ってリラックスできる施設となっている。無料送迎バスもある。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring offers good value with reasonable entry fees, features a radium spring, and provides a wide array of amenities including shampoo, conditioner, body soap, and various skincare products.

Other reviews mention the staff can be impolite and the facility can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: Located north of Sanyo Expressway Kawachi IC, this hot spring area features a total of seven outdoor baths. It is a family-friendly facility with a free shuttle bus service.

name: 神田山温泉
sales_point: 広島ICの南方約6キロの市街地に位置する温泉地。清流太田川を眼下に風光明媚な環境。温泉は飲用可。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hot spring inn offers well-maintained rooms and facilities, including a pool, training room, and hot springs with city views. They also highlight the reasonable prices, delicious meals, and helpful staff.

Some reviews mention access can be difficult without a car.
sales_point_en: Situated about 6 kilometers south of Hiroshima IC in an urban area, this hot spring offers scenic views of the clear Ota River. The water is also drinkable.

name: 木江温泉
location: 広島県 豊田郡大崎上島町
sales_point: 瀬戸内海国立公園の真ん中、大崎上島の岬に位置する温泉地。夏は海水浴、秋はみかん狩り、年間を通じて多島美と潮の香り、そして瀬戸の小魚を堪能することが出来る。
review_summary: People say this hotel offers stunning views of the Seto Inland Sea and its islands from the rooms, lobby, and especially the open-air baths. They also highlight the delicious and high-quality meals, with many praising the fresh sashimi and local ingredients. Guests mention the staff's warm and attentive service, contributing to a relaxing and memorable stay.
sales_point_en: Located at the tip of Osaki Kamijima in the Setouchi National Park, this hot spring area is perfect for summer swimming, autumn mandarin picking, and enjoying the beauty of the islands and the scent of the tide year-round.

name: 県民の浜温泉
sales_point: 呉市沖合、上蒲刈島に位置する温泉地。平成12年1月には川尻町と下蒲刈町経由で、蒲刈町まで橋が完成しアクセスが便利になる。
sales_point_en: This hot spring area is located off the coast of Kure City on Kamikamagari Island. A bridge connecting to Kamagari Town was completed in January 2000, making access more convenient.

name: 甲山温泉
location: 広島県 世羅郡世羅町
sales_point: 神農湖の西方、甲山町中心部に位置する温泉地。日帰り入浴もでき、近郊の人々の保養・休養の場とても親しまれている。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring facility offers a variety of saunas, including dry, salt, and mist, as well as a beneficial medicinal bath, and is often uncrowded.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be poorly maintained and the baths can be soiled.
sales_point_en: Located west of Shinnou Lake in the center of Koyama Town, this hot spring area is popular for day-use bathing and serves as a place for relaxation for local residents.

name: 甲奴温泉
sales_point: 上下川の支流沿いに位置する温泉地。甲奴町の中心部にある山あいの静かな環境で保養・休養に好適。
sales_point_en: Situated along a tributary of the Joge River, this hot spring area is in a quiet mountain environment in the center of Koyatsu Town, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 高茂温泉
sales_point: 山深い西城川のほとりに人里離れてひっそりと佇む温泉地。眼下に広がる川の景色は美しく、山菜料理等が味わえる。静かな環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。
sales_point_en: Nestled quietly by the deep Nishikigawa River, this hot spring area offers beautiful river views and serves delicious wild vegetable dishes. It is in a tranquil environment, perfect for relaxation.

name: 境ケ浜ラドン温泉
sales_point: 瀬戸内海を望む丘の上に位置する温泉地。プールやテニスコートがあり、バーベキューも楽しめる。海水浴は内海町まで船が出ており、島で泳ぐこともできる。
review_summary:
Reviewers consistently praise this hot spring facility for its wide variety of baths, including spacious open-air baths, silk baths, and good electric baths, alongside large saunas. Guests also highlight the delicious food and friendly staff.

Other reviews mention the service can be inconsistent.
sales_point_en: Located on a hill overlooking the Seto Inland Sea, this hot spring area features a pool and tennis courts, and offers barbecue facilities. Ferries to Utsumi Town allow for swimming in the sea.

name: 三段峡温泉
location: 広島県 山県郡安芸太田町
sales_point: 名勝三段峡の入口に位置する温泉地。渓谷沿いの風光明媚な環境にある。三段峡の自然探勝の基地として好適。日帰り入浴も可（要予約）。
review_summary: Visitors say this gorge offers stunning natural scenery, including beautiful autumn foliage and impressive river flows, with well-maintained walking trails suitable for exploration. They also highlight the enjoyable ferry ride at Kurobuchi and the availability of clean restrooms at the parking area. Guests mention the friendly staff at the parking lot and the delicious grilled yamame fish available at Kurobuchi-so.
sales_point_en: Located at the entrance of the scenic Sandankyo Gorge, this hot spring area is in a picturesque environment along the valley. It serves as a great base for exploring the natural beauty of Sandankyo, with day-use bathing available (reservation required).

name: 潮湯温泉
review_summary: Guests mention this ryokan offers spacious, clean rooms, some with private open-air baths and massage chairs, and delicious, beautifully presented in-room dining. They also highlight the rooftop terrace with stunning views of the torii gate, complimentary drinks, and ice cream. Visitors appreciate the exceptional service from the attentive staff, who provide helpful assistance and thoughtful gestures.

name: 水神の湯温泉
sales_point: 山の香りをたっぷり含んだおいしい空気に包まれている温泉地。閑静な環境で、小鳥たちの鳴き声や、せせらぎを聞きながら入浴できる。
sales_point_en: This hot spring area is enveloped in delicious air filled with the scent of the mountains. In a quiet environment, visitors can enjoy bathing while listening to the chirping of birds and the sound of a babbling brook.

name: せら香遊温泉
location: 広島県 世羅郡世羅町
sales_point: 世羅町に位置する温泉地。スポーツ施設が併設しており、スポーツ後の汗を流すのに最適。オートキャンプ場も隣接し、アウトドアレジャーも楽しめる。
sales_point_en: Located in Sera Town, this hot spring area features sports facilities, making it ideal for washing off sweat after sports. An auto camping site is also adjacent, allowing for outdoor leisure activities.

name: 千光寺温泉
sales_point: 尾道市街地に位置する温泉地。千光寺公園の中にあり、尾道観光拠点に便利。
review_summary: Visitors say this temple offers breathtaking panoramic views of Onomichi and the Seto Inland Sea, with its vibrant red main hall perched on a cliff. They also highlight the availability of unique amulets and handwritten goshuin, with some limited-edition options. Guests mention the staff are kind and helpful, and the atmosphere is peaceful and spiritual.
sales_point_en: Located in the city center of Onomichi, this hot spring area is within Chikugai Park, making it a convenient base for sightseeing in Onomichi.

name: たかみや湯の森温泉
location: 広島県 安芸高田市
sales_point: 高田ICの北東側に位置する温泉地。露天風呂（酒風呂）や薬草湯など、8つの湯を楽しみながら、ゆったりと過ごせる。
review_summary:
Visitors say this onsen features a wide variety of baths, including jacuzzis, carbonated baths, and unique sake baths, along with well-maintained saunas and cold plunges. They also highlight the clean facilities, spacious changing areas, and helpful staff.

Some reviews mention the water can be heavily chlorinated.
sales_point_en: Located northeast of Takada IC, this hot spring area offers eight types of baths, including outdoor baths (sake bath) and herbal baths, allowing visitors to relax and enjoy their time.

name: 田原温泉
location: 広島県 山県郡北広島町
sales_point: 熊城山東側山麓に位置する温泉地。川沿いにあり、釣りなどを楽しむことが出来る。静かな環境で保養向き。
sales_point_en: Situated at the foot of Kumojiyama on the eastern side, this hot spring area is along the river, allowing for activities like fishing. It is in a quiet environment, suitable for recuperation.

name: 千代田温泉
location: 広島県 山県郡北広島町
sales_point: 芸北山地の額田部に位置する温泉地。別名「赤湯」ともいわれており、古くから療養・保養に利用されている。
sales_point_en: Located in the Nakaida area of the Geihoku Mountains, this hot spring area is also known as 'Akayu' and has been used for healing and recuperation since ancient times.

name: 筒賀温泉
location: 広島県 山県郡安芸太田町
sales_point: 筒賀役場の近く国道186号線沿いに位置する温泉地。のどかな田園風景の中にあり、休養・保養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along National Route 186, near Tsutsuga Town Hall. It is surrounded by tranquil rural scenery, making it ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 並滝寺湖粋園温泉
sales_point: 八本松駅の北方、並滝寺池西側に位置する温泉地。緑と水の豊かな環境で保養・静養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located to the north of Yahomatsu Station, on the west side of Namitakiji Lake. It is set in a rich environment of greenery and water, perfect for recuperation and relaxation.

name: 温井温泉
location: 広島県 山県郡安芸太田町
sales_point: 国道186号線沿いの温井ダム湖畔に位置する温泉地。2001年には日本で第2位のアーチ式コンクリートダムが完成する。紅葉の名所として知られる滝山峡や三段峡などが近い。
review_summary:
Guests mention the beautiful, expansive views from the rooms and the clean, well-maintained hot springs, which are great for cold days. They also highlight the delicious, voluminous meals, especially the sweet steamed vegetables, and the kind staff who make it easy for families with children.

Other reviews mention the hot water can be cold.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located by the Mizuki Dam Lake along National Route 186. In 2001, Japan's second-largest arch concrete dam was completed here. It is close to famous autumn foliage spots like Takiyama Gorge and Sandan Gorge.

name: 比婆山温泉
sales_point: 比婆山連峰を間近にした、六ノ原川上流の谷あいに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、比婆山登山の基地に便利。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in a valley upstream of the Rokunohara River, close to the Hiba Mountain Range. It offers a quiet environment and is convenient as a base for climbing Hiba Mountain.

name: 比和温泉
sales_point: 比婆山連峰の南西側山麓に位置する温泉地。山あいの静かな環境にある。保養・静養に好適。
review_summary: People say this onsen features a clean facility with well-maintained changing rooms and spotless restrooms. They also highlight the affordable 360 yen entry fee and the smooth, skin-beautifying quality of the hot spring water. Guests mention the quiet atmosphere, often allowing for a private and relaxing bathing experience.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the southwestern foothills of the Hiba Mountain Range. It is situated in a quiet mountain environment, ideal for recuperation and relaxation.

name: ホリスリゾート温泉
sales_point: 大柿町の西部の沖野島に位置する温泉地。いりこやみかん、海の幸が美味。温暖で風光明媚な環境にある。日帰り入浴可。
review_summary: People say this hotel offers stunning ocean views from all rooms and features a unique hot spring with rare, free-flowing salt spring water that leaves skin smooth. They also highlight the delicious French-style dinners and the complimentary drinks and snacks available in the lounge. Guests mention the attentive staff and the overall clean, relaxing atmosphere.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on Okino Island in the western part of Oogaki Town. Known for its delicious dried sardines, mandarins, and seafood, it is set in a warm and picturesque environment. Day-use bathing is available.

name: みはらし温泉
sales_point: 三原市の南方、瀬戸内海を望む温泉地。地下1987ｍから湧き出る温泉は、広島県一の高温泉(45.1℃)といわれている。瀬戸を見ながらの展望風呂が大人気。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located south of Mihara City, overlooking the Seto Inland Sea. The hot spring, which gushes from 1987 meters underground, is said to be the hottest in Hiroshima Prefecture (45.1°C). The observation bath with views of the Seto is very popular.

name: 宮浜温泉
sales_point: 海辺に位置する温泉地。眼前に宮島を望み、風光明媚な環境にある。毎年２月に地元名産のカキを使ったお祭りがあり、多くの観光客で賑わう。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located by the sea, offering views of Miyajima. It is set in a scenic environment and hosts a local oyster festival every February, attracting many tourists.

name: 矢野温泉
sales_point: 湯川公園の麓に位置する温泉地。山間の閑静な環境で保養・療養に好適。790年前の発見と伝えられ歴史が永い。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of Yukawa Park. It is in a quiet mountain environment, ideal for recuperation and therapy. It is said to have been discovered 790 years ago, boasting a long history. It is designated as a national health resort.

name: 山野温泉
sales_point: 福山市北部、竜頭の滝の下流に位置する温泉地。川沿いにあり、夏は釣りなど楽しむことが出来る。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the northern part of Fukuyama City, downstream of the Ryuto Falls. It is along the river, where visitors can enjoy fishing in the summer.

name: 湯来温泉
sales_point: 1500年前に発見されたと伝えられる温泉地。渓谷沿いの閑静な環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。広島県下最大の温泉地で、国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring inn offers a wide variety of baths, including an open-air bath with beautiful seasonal views of the river and mountains, and delicious meals. They also highlight the clean facilities, reasonable prices, and helpful staff.

Other reviews mention the bath can be too cold or too warm.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area believed to have been discovered 1500 years ago. It is situated in a quiet environment along a valley, ideal for recuperation and therapy. It is the largest hot spring area in Hiroshima Prefecture and is designated as a national health resort.

name: 湯坂温泉
sales_point: 加茂川沿いに位置する温泉地。安芸の小京都と呼ばれる町並みは、江戸時代のまま保存されている。伊勢両宮社が目前にあり、観光拠点に好適。
review_summary:
Guests consistently praise this inn for its beautiful and expansive Japanese garden, along with complimentary sake tasting and coffee. They also highlight the comfortable rooms and the attentive staff.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Kamo River. The town, known as the 'Little Kyoto of Aki,' has preserved its Edo period architecture. The Ise Ryoju Shrine is right in front, making it a great base for sightseeing.

name: 湯の川温泉
sales_point: 奈良時代に湧出したと伝えられる歴史ある温泉地。静かな環境にあり、休養・保養に好適
review_summary: Visitors say this hot spring features a hot indoor bath and a cold outdoor waterfall-like "utatase-yu" for a refreshing contrast, which many find effective for relieving muscle stiffness. They also highlight the affordable entry fee and the nostalgic, traditional public bath atmosphere. Guests mention the natural surroundings, including friendly cats and chickens, enhance the relaxing experience.
sales_point_en: A historic hot spring area believed to have emerged during the Nara period. It is in a quiet environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 湯之元峡長者温泉
sales_point: 東広島市の中心部西条に位置する温泉地。ラドンを多く含んだお湯は保養に最適。日本酒のふるさと西条の名酒がふんだんに入った酒露天風呂もある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in Saijo, the center of Higashihiroshima City. The water, rich in radon, is perfect for recuperation. There is also an outdoor bath infused with the famous sake from Saijo.

name: 湯の山温泉
sales_point: 1200年前に発見されたと伝えられる温泉地。徳川時代には藩主の湯治場として栄えた。自然環境に恵まれ、「打たせ湯」が有名。保養・療養に好適。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary: Visitors say this hot spring features a hot indoor bath and a cold outdoor waterfall-like "utatase-yu" for a refreshing contrast, which many find effective for relieving muscle stiffness. They also highlight the affordable entry fee and the nostalgic, traditional public bath atmosphere. Guests mention the natural surroundings, including friendly cats and chickens, enhance the relaxing experience.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area believed to have been discovered 1200 years ago. It flourished as a healing place for feudal lords during the Tokugawa period. Blessed with a natural environment, it is famous for its 'waterfall bath' and is ideal for recuperation and therapy, designated as a national health resort.

name: 養老温泉
location: 広島県 山県郡北広島町
sales_point: 八千代湖の西側に位置する温泉地。千代田ICから約2キロのところにある百年続くひなびた湯宿で、山間に響く野鳥の声が心身共にくつろぎを与えてくれる。
review_summary: People say this hot spring inn offers delicious and hearty meals, including tempura, and features a charming retro atmosphere with Showa-era exhibits. They also highlight the hot, relaxing tiled baths and the clean, modernized guest rooms. Guests mention the staff are warm, kind, and provide excellent service, even accommodating special requests.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the west side of Yachiyo Lake. It is a rustic inn that has been in operation for a hundred years, about 2 kilometers from Chiyoda IC, where the sounds of wild birds in the mountains provide relaxation for both body and mind.

name: 養老温泉
sales_point: 藤井川沿いに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、保養に好適。文学と歴史の町尾道の散策に最適。
review_summary: People say this hot spring inn offers delicious and hearty meals, including tempura, and features a charming retro atmosphere with Showa-era exhibits. They also highlight the hot, relaxing tiled baths and the clean, modernized guest rooms. Guests mention the staff are warm, kind, and provide excellent service, even accommodating special requests.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Fujii River. It is in a quiet environment, ideal for recuperation. It is perfect for exploring the literary and historical town of Onomichi.

name: 龍温泉
location: 広島県 山県郡北広島町
sales_point: 千代田ICの南方約3キロに位置する温泉地。スポーツ施設が充実しており、テニス、バレー等楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located about 3 kilometers south of Chiyoda IC. It has excellent sports facilities, allowing visitors to enjoy tennis, volleyball, and more.

name: 龍頭峡温泉
location: 広島県 山県郡安芸太田町
sales_point: 渓谷美で知られる名勝、龍頭峡入口に位置する温泉地。渓谷散策の後にゆったりとくつろぐことが出来る。龍頭峡探勝の基地に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the entrance of the scenic Ryuto Gorge, known for its beautiful valleys. Visitors can relax comfortably after exploring the gorge, making it a great base for gorge exploration.

name: 岩井温泉
location: 鳥取県 岩美郡岩美町
sales_point: 1200年の歴史を持つ温泉地。蒲生川に沿った閑静な環境。「湯かむりの唄」を唄いながら柄杓で湯をかむる独特の風習が伝えられる。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area with a history of 1200 years. It is situated in a quiet environment along the Gamogawa River. A unique tradition of pouring hot water while singing 'Yukamuri no Uta' has been passed down. It is designated as a national health resort.

name: 皆生温泉
sales_point: 弓ヶ浜の海岸に位置する温泉地。白砂青松の海岸の景観と伯耆富士と呼ばれる大山の眺望が良い。夏季は海水浴が楽しめる。通年新鮮な日本海の幸が味わえ、米子の奥座敷として賑わっている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the coast of Yumigahama. It offers beautiful views of the white sandy beach and the mountain known as Mount Daisen, also called Hōki Fuji. Enjoy swimming in the sea during summer, and savor fresh seafood from the Sea of Japan year-round, making it a popular retreat in Yonago.

name: 鹿野温泉
sales_point: 西因幡県立自然公園、鷲峰山の北側山麓に位置する温泉地。田園風景の中にあり、保養・静養に好適。桜の名所の鹿野城跡が近い。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
review_summary:
Guests mention this inn offers delicious, beautifully presented meals, including fresh seafood and local beef, with many highlighting the excellent hot springs, especially the open-air baths. They also appreciate the attentive staff, the quiet, relaxing atmosphere, and the good value for the price.

Some reviews mention the rooms can be dated.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foothills of Washibōzan in the Nishiinaba Prefectural Natural Park. Surrounded by rural landscapes, it is ideal for relaxation and recuperation. Close to the famous cherry blossom site at the ruins of Kano Castle. Designated as a national health resort.

name: 関金（梨の花温泉郷）
sales_point: 矢送川沿いの山裾に位置する温泉地。鳥取県中部温泉郷に数えられ、1300年の歴史がある。日本有数のラジウム含有量を誇る。閑静な環境で、保養・休養に好適。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of the mountains along the Yasonogawa River. It has a history of 1300 years and is known for its high radium content. The tranquil environment makes it suitable for recuperation and relaxation. Designated as a national health resort.

name: 大山温泉
location: 鳥取県 西伯郡伯耆町
sales_point: 名峰大山の山裾に位置する温泉地。自然の中で四季の移り変わりを感じることができる。キャンプ、スキー、登山を楽しむ人々で一年中賑わう。
review_summary:
Guests consistently praise this hotel for its spacious rooms boasting impressive views of either Mt. Daisen or the Sea of Japan, and they particularly enjoy the wide selection of delicious buffet options available for both breakfast and dinner. Furthermore, reviewers highlight the inclusive lounge offering complimentary drinks and snacks, alongside the large and clean hot spring baths.

Other reviews mention the rooms can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of the majestic Mount Daisen. Experience the changing seasons in nature. It is bustling year-round with people enjoying camping, skiing, and mountain climbing.

name: 東郷（梨の花温泉郷）
location: 鳥取県 東伯郡湯梨浜町
sales_point: 東郷湖の南東岸に位置する明治時代に開かれた温泉地で、鳥取県中部温泉郷のひとつに数えられる。湖畔には県立の中国庭園「燕趙園」がある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area established in the Meiji era, located on the southeast shore of Lake Tōgō, counted among the hot springs in central Tottori Prefecture. The lakeside features the prefectural Chinese garden 'Enchōen'.

name: 鳥取温泉
sales_point: 県都・鳥取市の中心に位置する温泉地。開湯は明治37年で気軽に立ち寄れる公衆浴場もある。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring facility offers a wide variety of baths, including spacious indoor and outdoor options, carbonated springs, and large saunas. They also highlight the delicious and reasonably priced food at the on-site restaurant, and the convenient late operating hours.

Some reviews mention it can be crowded.
sales_point_en: Located in the center of Tottori City, the prefectural capital. Opened in 1904, it features public baths that are easily accessible.

name: 浜村温泉
sales_point: 日本海沿いに位置する温泉地。美しい砂浜、目前にひろがる日本海の景観がよい。「魚見台」展望台からの眺望は絶景。民謡「貝がら節」で有名。
review_summary:
Guests mention this traditional Japanese inn offers delicious and abundant meals, including fresh sashimi and crab, and spacious Japanese-style rooms. They also highlight the relaxing hot spring baths, friendly staff, and reasonable prices for the quality of food.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be dated.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Sea of Japan. It boasts beautiful sandy beaches and stunning views of the Sea of Japan. The view from the 'Uomidaidai' observation deck is spectacular. Famous for the folk song 'Kaigara-bushi'.

name: はわい（梨の花温泉郷）
location: 鳥取県 東伯郡湯梨浜町
sales_point: 東郷湖西岸に位置する温泉地。湖に突き出した岬にあり、湖上に浮かぶような環境にある。自然環境に恵まれ、眺望が良い。鳥取県中部温泉郷のひとつに数えられる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the western shore of Lake Tōgō. Situated on a peninsula that juts out into the lake, it offers a floating-like environment. Blessed with natural surroundings and great views, it is counted among the hot springs in central Tottori Prefecture.

name: 日吉津温泉
location: 鳥取県 西伯郡日吉津村
sales_point: 日野川の河口近くに位置する温泉地。夜見ヶ浜、美保湾、大山などの眺望が良い。目の前が海岸になっていて、夏季は海水浴が楽しめる。
review_summary:
Visitors say this mall offers a wide variety of stores, including a cinema and diverse food court options, with many local souvenirs available. They also highlight the spacious parking and convenient location near the interchange.

Other reviews mention the staff can be unhelpful.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near the mouth of the Hino River. It offers great views of Yomiga-hama, Miho Bay, and Mount Daisen. The beach is right in front, making it enjoyable for swimming in the summer.

name: 三朝（梨の花温泉郷）
location: 鳥取県 東伯郡三朝町
sales_point: 鳥取県中部温泉郷の中核となる温泉地。世界屈指のラジウム含有量を誇る。三徳川岸の露天風呂「河原風呂」が名物。温泉街には「湯の街ギャラリー」が点在する。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring inn offers a wide variety of delicious dishes, including crab, steak, and a breakfast buffet with many options. They also highlight the excellent quality of the radium hot springs, which are known for their healing properties, and the attentive staff.

Some reviews mention the service can be inefficient.
sales_point_en: A core hot spring area in central Tottori Prefecture, known for its world-class radium content. The open-air bath 'Kawara-buro' along the Mitoku River is a specialty. The hot spring town features the 'Yunomachi Gallery' scattered throughout.

name: 吉岡温泉
sales_point: 1000年前に発見され徳川時代には鳥取藩主の浴場も設置されていたと伝えられる。保養・療養に好適。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
sales_point_en: Discovered 1000 years ago, it is said that a bathhouse for the Tottori feudal lord was established during the Tokugawa period. It is suitable for recuperation and therapy, and is designated as a national health resort.
